We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the statute of limitations for the above-referenced account. We appreciate the opportunity to review the matter and provide a response.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), we are required to verify the accuracy of the debt and provide you with information regarding the original creditor, Citylink Communications. Our records indicate that the original creditor charged off the account on September 27, 2022. However, we have also noted that you made a payment on May 8, 2023, which may impact the statute of limitations.

We will conduct an investigation into the matter and provide you with a response regarding the statute of limitations. We will also review our records to ensure that the account is accurately reflected. Please note that, under Tennessee state law, the statute of limitations for debt collection is six years from the date of the last payment. In this case, the last payment was made on May 8, 2023.

We will provide you with a written validation of the debt, as required by the FDCPA, and will also provide you with information regarding the original creditor and the amount owed, which is currently $1,672.88.

You have the right to dispute this debt further, and we encourage you to contact us if you have any additional information or concerns.
